name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and runs Nginx as a multi-site HTTPS web server, creating per-site document roots and sample content, rendering site configurations, and enabling sites.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication on port 6379, creates its log directory, and applies required configuration compatibility settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, provisions its database and credentials, and manages a systemd service running Uvicorn on port 8000.
